Class RmiServer

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.network.rmi.server.RmiServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualServerRmi, VirtualServer<VirtualViewRmi>, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiServer extends UnicastRemoteObject implements VirtualServerRmi
RMI server. Owns (or shares) a LobbyManager and routes all client calls to it. When started via CombinedServer, it receives a shared LobbyManager so that RMI and Socket players can join the same games. When started standalone (its own main()), it creates its own LobbyManager. Heartbeat: for each client that logs in, a ScheduledExecutorService periodically calls clientView.ping(). If RemoteException → client disconnected → lobbyManager.handleDisconnect(nick). RMI is synchronous, so a successful ping() return IS the implicit pong.
